clusters.mechanism_claim: Exactly-one Frank execution is not safe unless the same monotonically fenced execution epoch is revalidated across state writes, response emission, effect reservation/start and recovery transitions.
clusters.predicted_observation: A stale holder may still cross a downstream effect/state boundary when presence, physical exclusion and effect lifecycle are individually correct but not compositionally bound.
clusters.falsifier: Current-main composed crash/takeover/effect matrix shows stale holder cannot write, emit or begin/retry an effect without a shared semantic epoch fence and recovery proof.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: Advisory physical flock may mask semantic defect on ordinary one-process paths.

clusters.mechanism_claim: Adaptive recurrent compute can improve difficult reasoning/control episodes when continuation is outcome/pressure gated rather than fixed or always-on.
clusters.predicted_observation: Matched hard episodes benefit from additional recurrence while easy episodes terminate earlier; fixed recurrence wastes compute or overthinks.
clusters.falsifier: Event-driven/fixed-budget baseline matches or beats adaptive recurrence on outcome, latency, recovery and stability across seeds/OOD.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: More compute rather than recurrence mechanism may explain gains.

clusters.mechanism_claim: Long-horizon memory should preserve/reconstruct execution state and selectively intervene when decision-relevant state would otherwise decay, rather than relying on semantic-similarity retrieval or always-on context exposure.
clusters.predicted_observation: Selective state intervention lowers forgotten-constraint/repeated-error rates and token cost versus passive retrieval/full-bank exposure.
clusters.falsifier: Passive bounded retrieval with equivalent context budget matches or beats selective intervention on long-horizon task success and state-integrity faults.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: A separate memory-agent architecture may gain from extra model compute rather than intervention timing.

clusters.mechanism_claim: Separating untrusted web data from privileged control/effect channels with typed provenance/capability or information-flow enforcement materially reduces indirect prompt-injection authority escalation.
clusters.predicted_observation: Adversarial web/tool-result text can alter observed data but cannot directly mint control flow, confidentiality release or effect authority.
clusters.falsifier: Contextual manipulation causes forbidden flows despite valid structural labels and deterministic gates, or acceptable benign tasks collapse under policy constraints.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: Contextual norms and trusted-user intent can themselves be ambiguous or adversarially reframed.

clusters.mechanism_claim: Bounded proactive goal/opportunity selection can improve long-horizon utility when self-generated activity is gated by controllability/information value, current-user handoff, effect authority and independently verified outcomes.
clusters.predicted_observation: Useful unattended progress increases without preemption, compulsive activity or self-reward inflation.
clusters.falsifier: Reactive-only baseline matches utility or proactive policy increases distraction, unsafe task switching, resource waste or goal drift under equal budgets.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: Intrinsic-motivation signals can optimize activity proxies instead of external usefulness.

clusters.mechanism_claim: A typed semantic IR with explicit provenance/effect identities can make identity, authority and re-entry invariants machine-checkable across Frank cognition rather than leaving them as prompt conventions.
clusters.predicted_observation: Typed invalid authority/identity flows are rejected before runtime effects and semantic replay is more stable than an equivalent untyped/prompt-only representation.
clusters.falsifier: A simpler conventional typed host-language/IDL implementation achieves equal semantic preservation, security and replay at lower complexity/cost.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: ClayCode may duplicate semantics already safely expressible in conventional typed systems.

clusters.mechanism_claim: Dependency-aware targeted delivery plus anti-entropy can preserve most required cross-worker information while reducing full broadcast load.
clusters.predicted_observation: Real-repo replay retains near-broadcast required-recipient recall at materially lower payload cost and recovers missing/stale edges.
clusters.falsifier: Missing/stale dependency edges cause unacceptable silent misses or broadcast dominates after accounting for anti-entropy/recovery cost.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: Synthetic dependency distributions understate real repository semantic drift.

clusters.mechanism_claim: Typed, multi-timescale reward/control state downstream of verified outcomes and causal credit is more robust than scalar self-reward for persistence/disengagement and long-horizon learning.
clusters.predicted_observation: Typed successor reduces self-reward poisoning and task-safety tradeoff collapse while preserving useful persistence.
clusters.falsifier: Simpler verified-outcome scalar plus homeostasis baseline matches task, safety, calibration, OOD and recovery metrics.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: Extra dimensions may only add tuning freedom without causal value.

clusters.mechanism_claim: Preserving unresolved alternatives and reopening them under stagnation can improve escape from stale attractors without destabilizing healthy convergence.
clusters.predicted_observation: Stalled episodes recover more often under evidence-gated branch reopening than under single-route continuation.
clusters.falsifier: Beam/top-k alternative storage or simple reseeding matches recovery at lower complexity, or reopening increases instability/latency.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: Benefit may come from generic diversity rather than higher-order Hyperposition structure.

clusters.mechanism_claim: Current authoritative source/replay/runtime identity surfaces must all converge on self.root; compatibility aliases are safe only when they cannot restamp stale SELF semantics.
clusters.predicted_observation: Source-to-replay migration eliminates contamination while preserving Andreas/Gabriel/client/token/peer external relations and restart continuity.
clusters.falsifier: Fresh current-main boot/API/replay/restart traces already resolve every authoritative identity path to self.root and stale texts are unreachable.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: Draft branch evidence may not reflect merged current-main state.
